en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5518 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Mathanna ibn Rashid from Abu Basir from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

I asked Imam (as) about an orphan who had memorized the Qur'an and had no deficiency in his intellect. The one holding his wealth wishes to invest it until the orphan reaches puberty and then hand over his wealth to him.
Imam (as) said: "Even if he reaches puberty but does not have sound intellect, nothing should ever be handed over to him."
